agm.agm_result:
Agenda #1: Shareholders approved the 2025 Annual Report and audited Financial Statements, granting a full release and discharge to the Board of Directors and Commissioners for their 2025 management and supervision.
Agenda #2: The meeting approved a total cash dividend of Rp133.50 per share for the 2025 fiscal year and allocated Rp100 million to the company's reserve fund.
Agenda #3: Authority was delegated to the Board of Commissioners to select a registered Public Accountant for the 2026 fiscal year audit and determine the associated honorarium.
Agenda #4: Shareholders accepted board resignations and appointed new members for the 2026-2029 term, while establishing a remuneration system for the Board of Commissioners capped at 0.2% of consolidated net sales.
Agenda #5: The meeting approved amending Article 3 of the Articles of Association to align the company’s business purposes and activities with the 2025 Indonesia Standard Industrial Classification (KBLI 2025).
Agenda #6: Shareholders approved amending Article 16 Paragraph 6 of the Articles of Association to update the duties and representation authorities of the Board of Directors.
